words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: He scooped soup with a spoon.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子舀汤。
words.en: A scoop is a tool like a large spoon which is used for picking up substances such as ice cream or an amount of a substance that is held in a scoop. It can also refer to an important or exciting news story that is reported in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast before anyone else reports it.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.ex: He zipped up his jacket with the zipper.
words.ex_cn: 他用拉链拉上了夹克。
words.en: A zipper is a device consisting of two strips of metal or plastic with interlocking projections closed or opened by pulling a slide along them, used to fasten openings in clothing, bags, etc.

words.ex: The zip on my jacket is broken.
words.ex_cn: 我的夹克上的拉链坏了。
words.en: A zip is a device used to fasten openings in clothes or bags, consisting of two rows of metal or plastic teeth that are pulled together or apart by a sliding tab. It can also refer to energy or speed.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有道理；说得对
words.ex: You have a point about saving money.
words.ex_cn: 你关于存钱的说法有道理。
words.en: If someone has a point, what they say is reasonable or correct, especially when they are disagreeing with you.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: He had an accidental fall while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他在走路时不小心摔了一跤。
words.en: An accidental event happens by chance, without being planned.

words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.ex: The ruler made laws for his people.
words.ex_cn: 这位统治者为他的人民制定法律。
words.en: A ruler is a person who governs or commands. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.ex: The temperature remains high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天温度保持很高。
words.en: If someone or something remains in a particular state or condition, they stay in that state or condition and do not change.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.tr:
v. 熔炼；冶炼
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
n. 胡瓜鱼
words.ex: They smelt iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 他们熔炼铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: To smelt means to extract metal from ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.tr: v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He smelled the flowers before picking them.
words.ex_cn: 他在摘花之前先闻了闻。
words.en: To perceive or detect the odor or scent of something by means of the olfactory senses.

words.ex: Saint Francis loved animals and helped the poor.
words.ex_cn: 圣方济各热爱动物并帮助穷人。
words.en: A saint is a person who is recognized as having an exceptional degree of holiness, likeness, or closeness to God.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: The popularity of this song grew quickly on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在社交媒体上的流行迅速增长。
words.en: The state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: He is without doubt the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is definitely true or will definitely happen

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.ex: Somebody left their umbrella here.
words.ex_cn: 某人把伞落在这里了。
words.en: Somebody refers to a person who is not known or not specifically named.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: The phone rang at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 电话在午夜响了。
words.en: To make a telephone call; to cause a bell or similar device to make a sound; to surround or encircle; a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority.

words.ex: The phone rung three times before she answered.
words.ex_cn: 电话响了三声，她才接起来。
words.en: A rung is one of the horizontal supports on a ladder for a person's foot.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.ex: There was a sudden noise in the night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里突然传来一阵响声。
words.en: If something is sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: All of a sudden, the dog started barking.
words.ex_cn: 突然间，狗开始叫了。
words.en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The bell rang at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 铃在早上八点响了。
words.en: A bell is a device that makes a ringing sound and is used to give a signal or to attract attention.

words.ex: He ate a biscuit with tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.ex: She ate a cookie after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她在午饭后吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A cookie is a small sweet cake, typically round and flat, that is baked and often served as a snack.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: The fries are crispy and hot.
words.ex_cn: 薯条又脆又热。
words.en: Something that is crispy is pleasantly hard and dry, and makes a sharp sound when you break it or bite it.

words.ex: The soup is too salty.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太咸了。
words.en: Something that is salty contains salt or tastes of salt.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: I took his book by mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我误拿了她的书。
words.en: If you do something by mistake, you do it without intending to, because you have confused it with something else or because you are not paying attention.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr: phrase. 奥林匹克运动会；奥运会
words.ex: The Olympics happen every four years.
words.ex_cn: 奥运会每四年举行一次。
words.en: The Olympic Games are a major international event featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.

words.ex: He bought a Canadian maple syrup.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一瓶加拿大的枫糖浆。
words.en: Of or relating to Canada or its people, culture, or language.

words.ex: She will divide the cake into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 她将把蛋糕分成两部分。
words.en: If you divide something, you separate it into two or more parts.

words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate something into parts or sections.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.ex: Not only does he play the piano, but also he sings well.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅会弹钢琴，而且唱得也很好。
words.en: Used to emphasize that two things are true, especially when this is surprising or impressive.

words.ex: I look up to my teacher because she is kind and smart.
words.ex_cn: 我尊敬我的老师，因为她善良又聪明。
words.en: If you look up to someone, you respect and admire them.

words.ex: The firefighter is a hero for saving the child.
words.ex_cn: 消防员救了孩子，是个英雄。
words.en: A hero is a person who is admired for their courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上公交车。
words.en: Almost, but not quite; very close to.

words.ex: He lives in Berlin.
words.ex_cn: 他住在柏林。
words.en: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany, known for its historical significance, cultural institutions, and modern architecture.

words.tr: abbr. 美国职业篮球联赛；“National Basketball Association”的缩写
words.ex: He watches NBA games every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都看NBA比赛。
words.en: The National Basketball Association (NBA) is a professional basketball league in North America.

words.tr: phrase. 美国职业篮球联赛
words.ex: He dreams of playing in the National Basketball Association.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想着能在美國職業籃球聯賽打球。
words.en: The principal professional basketball league in the United States and Canada.

words.tr:
abbr. 成本效益分析；“Cost-Benefit Analysis”的缩写
abbr. 中国职业篮球联赛；“China Basketball Association”的缩写
words.ex: The company did a cba before launching the new product.
words.ex_cn: 公司在推出新产品之前做了成本效益分析。
words.en: The Chinese Basketball Association, the top-tier professional basketball league in China.

words.tr: phrase. 中国篮球协会（中国篮球运动的管理机构）
words.ex: He works for the China Basketball Association.
words.ex_cn: 他为中国篮球协会工作。
words.en: The China Basketball Association is the governing body of basketball in China, responsible for organizing basketball leagues, tournaments, and national teams.

words.ex: Roy is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 罗伊正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: Royal pertains to a king or queen or their family, or to something connected with them.

words.ex: Whitcomb was a well-known figure in the local community.
words.ex_cn: 惠特科姆是当地社区的知名人物。
words.en: A surname, typically of English origin, often associated with place names meaning 'white valley' or 'white hollow'.

words.ex: She wears a ruby ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚红宝石戒指。
words.en: A ruby is a precious stone that is typically a deep red color.

words.ex: Thomas Edison was a prolific inventor.
words.ex_cn: 托马斯·爱迪生是一位多产的发明家。
words.en: A male given name of Aramaic origin, meaning 'twin'; also used as a surname.

words.ex: George likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 乔治喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Greek name Georgios, meaning 'farmer' or 'earth-worker'.

words.ex: James is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 詹姆士是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name, of Hebrew origin, meaning 'supplanter'.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.tr: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的
words.ex: He works part-time at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家咖啡店做兼职。
words.en: If someone is a part-time worker or has a part-time job, they work for only part of each day or week.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.ex: She wears a gold earring.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一只金耳环。
words.en: An earring is a piece of jewelry that you attach to your ear.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；喊叫；
v. 哭；哭泣；
words.ex: His cry woke up the whole house.
words.ex_cn: 他的哭泣惊醒了整个房子。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain; to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: He played badly in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中表现得很差。
words.en: If something is done badly or goes badly, it is not successful or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 顶嘴；回嘴；不服从地答话
words.ex: The child talked back to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 孩子顶撞了他妈妈。
words.en: To reply to someone in a rude or disrespectful manner, especially when being criticized or told to do something.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.ex: He is a teen who loves basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢篮球的十几岁少年。
words.en: A teen is a young person whose age is between thirteen and nineteen.

words.tr:
n. 遗憾；
v. 懊悔；
words.ex: He felt a deep regret after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失去工作后感到深深的遗憾。
words.en: If you regret something that you have done, you wish that you had not done it.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: phrase. 使…远离；把…隔离开；避免…接触
words.ex: Parents should keep children away from fire.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该让孩子远离火源。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from being near a particular place or person.

words.tr: phrase. 自己做决定；自主决策
words.ex: He can make his own decision about what to eat.
words.ex_cn: 他可以自己决定吃什么。
words.en: to decide something by oneself without relying on others' opinions or advice

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 妨碍；阻挡；干扰
words.ex: Don't let fear get in the way of your dreams.
words.ex_cn: 别让恐惧阻碍你的梦想。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or prevent something from happening.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place; to become involved in a situation or activity; to begin a particular period or stage; to record information in a book or computer.

words.tr: n. 毕加索（Pablo Picasso，西班牙画家，立体主义画派主要代表）；
words.ex: Picasso painted a famous blue period artwork.
words.ex_cn: 毕加索画了一幅著名的蓝色时期作品。
words.en: A Spanish painter, sculptor, printmaker, ceramicist, stage designer, poet and playwright who spent most of his adult life in France.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.ex_cn: 兔子跳过了小篱笆。
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是粉红色的。
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.ex: Does anybody know the answer?
words.ex_cn: 有人知道答案吗？
words.en: Any person at all; anyone.

words.tr: v. 发生；“happen”的现在分词； n. 事件；偶然发生的事；
words.ex: What is happening now?
words.ex_cn: 现在发生了什么？
words.en: an event or occurrence

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.ex: The policeman stopped the car.
words.ex_cn: 警察拦下了那辆车。
words.en: A policeman is a man who is a member of the police force.

words.ex: The policemen stopped the car.
words.ex_cn: 警察拦下了那辆车。
words.en: Policemen are members of the police force who are responsible for maintaining public order, preventing and detecting crime.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了外衣。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.ex: The child looked sleepy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后看起来想睡觉。
words.en: If you are sleepy, you are tired and ready to go to sleep.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: The dog runs after the ball every time.
words.ex_cn: 每次狗都追球跑。
words.en: To chase or pursue someone or something, often in a literal sense of running behind them to catch up.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 表达；表示；
adj. 明确的；
n. 特快列车；快件服务；
words.ex: He can express his feelings clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的感受。
words.en: If you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: She was born in Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在英国。
words.en: Britain is a country in Europe consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, known for its history, culture, and influence in the world.

words.ex: She lives in Great Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她住在英国。
words.en: Great Britain is an island in the North Atlantic Ocean off the northwest coast of continental Europe, comprising England, Scotland, and Wales.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.ex: They celebrate midsummer with fireworks and dancing.
words.ex_cn: 他们用烟花和舞蹈庆祝仲夏。
words.en: Midsummer is the period in the middle of summer, typically around the summer solstice, the longest day of the year.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: The burial took place at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 埋葬在日出时进行。
words.en: The act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a grave.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.ex: Many tourists visit Stonehenge in England.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客参观英国的巨石阵。
words.en: Stonehenge is a prehistoric monument in Wiltshire, England, consisting of a ring of standing stones, each around 13 feet high, seven feet wide, and weighing around 25 tons. It is one of the most famous landmarks in the United Kingdom and is regarded as a British cultural icon.

words.ex: Carla is walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 卡拉正走着去学校。
words.en: A common female given name, often used as a standalone reference or in a list of names.

words.tr: phrase. 乔安妮·凯瑟琳·罗琳，英国作家，《哈利·波特》系列小说的作者
words.ex: J.K. Rowling wrote the first Harry Potter book.
words.ex_cn: J.K. 罗琳写了第一本《哈利·波特》书。
words.en: J.K. Rowling is a British author best known for writing the Harry Potter fantasy series.

words.ex: Victor won the race last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 维克多上周日赢得了比赛。
words.en: A victor is someone who wins a competition, battle, or game.

words.ex: The fabric is made of thick jean.
words.ex_cn: 这种布料是由厚实的斜纹布制成的。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth, often called 'blue jeans' or just 'jeans'.

words.tr: phrase. 保罗·斯托克（人名，常见于英语国家）
words.ex: Paul Stoker teaches math at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 保罗·斯托克在本地学校教数学。
words.en: A male given name, typically used as a standalone reference or in a list of names.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: I love the lyrics of this song.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这首歌的歌词。
words.en: The words of a song, especially a pop song.

words.ex: She bought an Australian sheepskin coat.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件澳大利亚羊皮外套。
words.en: relating to Australia or its people

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.tr: phrase. 如果是那样的话；在那种情况下
words.ex: He didn't bring his book; in that case, I'll lend you mine.
words.ex_cn: 他没带书；那样的话，我借给你我的。
words.en: If that is the situation, then...

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.tr: adj. 卡住的；受困的； v. 粘贴；“stick”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The door is stuck and won't open.
words.ex_cn: 门卡住了，打不开。
words.en: If something is stuck in a particular position, it is fixed tightly in this position and is unable to move.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: There is plenty of food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有充足的食物。
words.en: A large or sufficient amount or quantity; more than enough.

words.ex: There is plenty of food on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上有很多食物。
words.en: A large quantity or number; more than enough.

words.ex: Please shut the door.
words.ex_cn: 请关上门。
words.en: To shut something means to move it so that it fills an opening or to move it so that it is no longer open.

words.ex: He shut off the lights before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前关掉了灯。
words.en: To stop the operation or flow of something by turning a switch, valve, or other control.

words.ex: He wants to be a superhero and save the world.
words.ex_cn: 他想成为一名超级英雄并拯救世界。
words.en: A superhero is a fictional character who has special powers and uses them to help people and fight against evil.

words.ex: I eat ice cream once in a while.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔吃冰淇淋。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr:
n. 意义；感知；理解力；知觉；
v. 感觉到；觉察出；意识到；
words.ex: The story has no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事没有意义。
words.en: A sense is a feeling or awareness about something, or a physical ability such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

words.ex: He felt sadness after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后感到悲伤。
words.en: Sadness is the feeling of being unhappy, especially because something bad has happened.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: v. 移动；“move”的现在分词；搬家； adj. 运动的；感人的；动人的；可移动的；
words.ex: The boy is moving his toy car.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩正在移动他的玩具车。
words.en: If something is moving, it makes you feel strongly touched or emotional.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.ex: I felt pity for the lonely child.
words.ex_cn: 我对那个孤独的孩子感到怜悯。
words.en: If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.ex: There are 5 apples and 3 oranges, in total 8 fruits.
words.ex_cn: 有5个苹果和3个橙子，总共8个水果。
words.en: as a whole; including everything or everyone

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典钢琴的大师。
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.tr: phrase. 第二次世界大战（1939–1945年）
words.ex: He learned about world war ii in history class.
words.ex_cn: 他在历史课上学到了第二次世界大战。
words.en: World War II, also known as the Second World War, was a global war that lasted from 1939 to 1945. The vast majority of the world's countries—including all the great powers—eventually formed two opposing military alliances: the Allies and the Axis.

words.tr: phrase. 黑衣人；指身着黑色西装、负责处理外星人事件的秘密政府特工（源自电影《黑衣人》系列）
words.ex: The men in black drove a black car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 那些穿黑衣的人开了一辆黑色的车，开得很快。
words.en: Men in Black refers to the characters from the 'Men in Black' film series or, more generally, to mysterious figures dressed in black suits.

words.tr: phrase. 功夫熊猫（美国动画电影及其主角的称呼）
words.ex: He loves watching Kung Fu Panda on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看《功夫熊猫》。
words.en: Kung Fu Panda is an animated movie that tells the story of Po, a panda who dreams of becoming a kung fu master.

words.ex: The company made a titanic effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司做出了巨大的努力来按时完成项目。
words.en: If you describe something as titanic, you mean that it is very big or important, and usually that it involves very powerful forces.

words.tr: phrase. 《帝企鹅日记》（纪录片名）；企鹅的行进
words.ex: The march of the penguins shows how they walk far in winter.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅的迁徙展示了它们在冬天如何走很远的路。
words.en: A documentary film that portrays the annual journey of emperor penguins in Antarctica.

words.tr: n. <主英>高空作业的建筑工人
words.ex: The spiderman cleaned the windows of the tall building.
words.ex_cn: 那个高空作业的建筑工人擦了高楼的窗户。
words.en: Spider-Man is a fictional superhero created by writer-editor Stan Lee and writer-artist Steve Ditko. He first appeared in the anthology comic book Amazing Fantasy #15 (Aug. 1962) in the Silver Age of Comic Books.

words.ex: Carmen sings loudly in the opera.
words.ex_cn: 卡门在歌剧中大声歌唱。
words.en: A female given name, also the title of a famous opera by Bizet.

words.ex: He earned a black belt, which is a third dan.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了黑带，那是三段。
words.en: A common male given name, often short for Daniel or a standalone name.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.ex: She gave him a sweet kiss goodnight.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他一个甜蜜的晚安之吻。
words.en: To touch or press your lips against someone or something as a sign of love or affection.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.tr: adj. 放松的；不拘束的； v. 放宽；“relax”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He sat in the chair with a relaxed smile.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上，面带放松的微笑。
words.en: If you are relaxed, you are calm and not worried or tense.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.ex: We eat lunch at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Noon is the middle of the day, 12 o'clock in the daytime.

words.ex: He became mad after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后变得发疯了。
words.en: If you say that someone is mad, you mean that they are very angry.

words.ex: He gets mad when he sees people littering.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到人们乱扔垃圾时，他会生气。
words.en: To become very angry or lose one's temper.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 努力；尽力；作出努力
words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力早起。
words.en: To attempt to do something, especially when it requires a significant amount of work or determination.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.tr: phrase. v. 清除掉；把...擦干净
words.ex: He used a cloth to clean off the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用布把桌子擦干净了。
words.en: To remove dirt, marks, or unwanted substances from the surface of something.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the board with chalk.
words.ex_cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
words.en: A soft white limestone (calcium carbonate) formed from the skeletal remains of sea creatures.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
words.ex_cn: 老师在黑板上写字。
words.en: A blackboard is a dark-colored board that you can write on with chalk, used especially in classrooms.

words.ex: The northern wind is cold in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的北风很冷。
words.en: Northern means situated in, directed towards, or facing the north.

words.ex: We walked along the coast and saw the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步，看到了大海。
words.en: The coast is the land along the edge of the sea or ocean.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: The eastern city has many old temples.
words.ex_cn: 东部的城市有许多古老的寺庙。
words.en: Eastern means in or from the east part of an area.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr:
adj. 值得的；有…价值；
n. 价值；
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.tr: phrase. 特意；不辞辛劳地做某事
words.ex: He goes out of his way to help his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他特意去帮助他的朋友们。
words.en: To make a special effort to do something; to inconvenience oneself in order to do something for someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 使……感到宾至如归；使……放松自在；让……感觉像在家一样
words.ex: She smiles and says hello to make me feel at home.
words.ex_cn: 她微笑着打招呼，让我感到宾至如归。
words.en: To make someone feel comfortable and relaxed, as if they were in their own home.

words.tr: adj. 青少年的；十来岁的；
words.ex: Teenage boys often like playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 青少年男孩通常喜欢打篮球。
words.en: Teenage is used to describe someone who is between the ages of 13 and 19, or something that is related to or typical of this age group.

words.ex: My granddaughter loves to paint pictures.
words.ex_cn: 我的外孙女喜欢画画。
words.en: A granddaughter is the daughter of your son or daughter.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.ex: He is getting used to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他正在习惯早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone, so that it/they no longer seem(s) new, strange, or difficult.

words.ex: He gave me a suggestion to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提了一个多吃蔬菜的建议。
words.en: A suggestion is an idea or plan that someone puts forward for consideration.

words.ex: He is traveling to Brazil next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要去巴西旅行。
words.en: Brazil is a country in South America, known for its vast Amazon rainforest and vibrant culture.

words.tr: n. 墨西哥（拉丁美洲国家）
words.ex: He lives in Mexico.
words.ex_cn: 他住在墨西哥。
words.en: Mexico is a country in the southern part of North America.

words.tr: abbr. 中国照明电器协会（China Association of Lighting Indus...
words.ex: Cali sets safety standards for light bulbs.
words.ex_cn: 中国照明电器协会制定了灯泡的安全标准。
words.en: A common female given name, often used as a standalone reference or in a list of names.

words.ex: She traveled to Colombia last summer.
words.ex_cn: 她去年夏天去了哥伦比亚。
words.en: A country in South America, known for its significant biodiversity, cultural heritage, and production of coffee and emeralds.

words.tr: n. 洛桑（瑞士西部城市）
words.ex: He lives in Lausanne, Switzerland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在瑞士的洛桑。
words.en: Lausanne is a city in Switzerland, situated on the shores of Lake Geneva. It is known for its picturesque setting and as the headquarters of the International Olympic Committee.

words.ex: He lives in Norway.
words.ex_cn: 他住在挪威。
words.en: A country in Northern Europe, known for its mountains, fjords, and the Northern Lights.

words.ex: Maria likes to read books every evening.
words.ex_cn: 玛丽亚喜欢每天晚上读书。
words.en: A common female given name, often used as a standalone reference or in a list of names.

words.tr: n. 凯蒂（女子名，Catherine的昵称）；
words.ex: Katie loves to draw pictures of cats.
words.ex_cn: 凯蒂喜欢画猫的图画。
words.en: A common female given name, often used as a standalone reference or in a list of names.

words.ex: Sato is a student in my class.
words.ex_cn: 佐藤是我的班级里的一名学生。
words.en: A common Japanese surname, often used as a standalone reference or in a list of names.

words.ex: Marie likes to read books every evening.
words.ex_cn: 玛丽喜欢每天晚上读书。
words.en: A common female given name, often used as a standalone reference or in a list of names.

words.ex: Teresa Lopez is a teacher at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 特蕾莎·洛佩兹是当地一所学校的老师。
words.en: A proper name, likely referring to a specific individual.

words.tr: phrase. 马克·勒布朗（美国游戏设计师，以《Ultima》系列及“8种趣味”理论闻名）
words.ex: Marc LeBlanc designed games and wrote about the eight kinds of fun.
words.ex_cn: 马克·勒布朗设计游戏，并撰写了关于八种趣味的理论。
words.en: A proper name, likely referring to a specific individual.

words.tr: adv. 更确切地说；宁可；相当；
words.ex: I don't like coffee; rather, I prefer tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡；更确切地说，我更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use rather to indicate that something is true to a fairly great extent, especially when you are talking about something unpleasant or undesirable.

words.ex: I would rather stay home than go out in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿在雨中出去。
words.en: If you say that you would rather do something or you'd rather do it, you mean that you would prefer to do it. If you say that you would rather not do something, you mean that you do not want to do it.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人发疯；把某人逼得受不了
words.ex: The loud music drives me crazy.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的音乐让我发疯。
words.en: To make someone extremely annoyed or upset.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使某人发疯；使某人极度烦恼或生气
words.ex: The loud noise drives me mad.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让我发疯。
words.en: To make someone extremely annoyed or angry.

words.tr: phrase. 越……越……（用于表达两个事物或情况之间的正比关系）
words.ex: The more you practice, the more you improve.
words.ex_cn: 你练习得越多，进步就越大。
words.en: Used to say that when an action or event continues, there will be a particular result.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.tr: 短语. 与某人做朋友；和某人友好相处
words.ex_cn: 我和汤姆在学校是朋友。
words.en: To have a friendly relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.ex: Their friendship lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友谊持续了二十年。
words.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；主要的；基本的；最好的；
words.ex: This is the prime reason for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 这是延误的首要原因。
words.en: Prime is used to describe something that is of the best possible quality, or the most important or basic part of something.

words.ex: The minister signed the new law.
words.ex_cn: 部长签署了新法律。
words.en: A minister is a person who is in charge of a particular government department or a member of the clergy in some Christian churches.

words.ex: The prime minister gave a speech yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 总理昨天发表了一次演讲。
words.en: The head of an elected government; the principal minister of a sovereign or state.

words.tr: n. 银行家；经营银行业者；
words.ex: The banker gave him a loan to start a business.
words.ex_cn: 这位银行家给了他一笔贷款来创业。
words.en: A banker is a person who owns or manages a bank or has an important position in a bank.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: The sky turned pale blue at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时，天空变成了淡蓝色。
words.en: Something that is pale is not strong or bright in color.

words.ex: There are nine queens in the palace.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有九个女王。
words.en: A queen is a woman who rules a country as its monarch or who is the wife of a king.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

words.ex: The police will examine the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查犯罪现场。
words.en: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

words.tr:
conj. 也不；也没有；
adv. 也不；也没有；
words.ex: He doesn't like coffee, nor does she.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢咖啡，她也不喜欢。
words.en: used before the second or last of a set of negative possibilities, usually after 'neither'

words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: used to introduce two or more negative possibilities, indicating that none of them is true or will happen

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: To start with, we need some water.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要一些水。
words.en: You use 'to start with' when you are mentioning the first or most basic thing in a series of things, or when you are giving the first or most basic reason for something.

words.tr:
adj. 灰色的；
n. 灰色；
words.ex: The sky is grey today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是灰色的。
words.en: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 使失望；辜负；放下；降低
words.ex: He let down his team by missing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他因为没参加比赛而让队友失望了。
words.en: To fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected.

words.ex: He kick the ball into the goal.
words.ex_cn: 他把球踢进了球门。
words.en: To strike or propel with the foot; a blow or thrust delivered by the foot.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人踢出去；强制某人离开；将某人移除（群组、平台、活动等）
words.ex: The coach kicked him off the team.
words.ex_cn: 教练把他从队里开除了。
words.en: To remove someone from a place, group, or activity, often in a forceful or abrupt manner.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人苛刻；对某人要求过严；使某人感到痛苦或不公平
words.ex: Don't be hard on him; he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 别对他太苛刻了，他已经尽力了。
words.en: To treat someone in a strict or harsh manner.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.ex: My teammate helped me win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我的队友帮我赢得了比赛。
words.en: A teammate is a fellow member of a team.

words.ex: He showed courage when he saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他从火中救出孩子时展现了勇气。
words.en: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.ex: They pull together to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力按时完成项目。
words.en: To work together as a team or group in order to achieve something.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.tr:
v. 点头；打盹
n. 点头
words.ex: He nodded when I asked if he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他是否累了时，他点了点头。
words.en: If you nod, you move your head downwards and upwards to show that you are answering 'yes' to a question, or to show agreement, understanding, or approval.

words.ex: They signed an agreement to share the costs.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份分担费用的协议。
words.en: An agreement is a formal decision about future action which is made by two or more people, groups, or organizations.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.ex: He disappointed his parents by failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他考试不及格，让父母失望了。
words.en: If things or people disappoint you, they are not as good as you had hoped, or do not do what you expected them to do.

words.tr: n. 伯特（男子名，Albert的昵称）
words.ex: He is bert, my neighbor who fixes bikes.
words.ex_cn: 他是伯特，我那个修自行车的邻居。
words.en: A proper name, often a nickname for Albert or Herbert, or a given name.

words.ex: She hung holly above the door for Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 她把冬青挂在门上方过圣诞节。
words.en: Holly is a type of evergreen tree or shrub with prickly leaves and red berries, often used as a decoration during Christmas.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.ex: By the time he arrived, the class had already started.
words.ex_cn: 他到的时候，课已经开始了。
words.en: Indicates that something has already happened before a particular time.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.ex: He oversleeps every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都睡过头。
words.en: To sleep longer than intended, especially so as to wake up late.

words.tr: v. 睡得太久，睡过头( oversleep的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: I overslept and missed my flight.
words.ex_cn: 我睡过头了，错过了我的航班。
words.en: To sleep longer than intended or beyond the usual waking time.

words.tr: phrase. 搭载某人一程；让某人搭便车
words.ex: He gives his sister a lift to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车送他妹妹去学校。
words.en: To provide someone with transportation, typically in one's own vehicle, or to help someone improve or advance in some way.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.ex: He stared at the moon all night.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚凝视着月亮。
words.en: To look fixedly or intently at someone or something.

words.ex: He stared at the money with disbelief.
words.ex_cn: 他难以置信地盯着那些钱。
words.en: Disbelief is the feeling of not being able to believe that something is true or real.

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.ex: The wood burns slowly in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 木头在火中缓慢燃烧。
words.en: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that there is a burn there. When you burn something, you destroy or damage it with fire or heat.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；烧伤；“burn”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The wood burnt in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 木头在火中燃烧了。
words.en: Damaged or injured by fire or heat.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；烧伤；“burn”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The wood burned in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头在壁炉里燃烧了。
words.en: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that it is burning. If something is burning, it is on fire.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；“burn”的现在分词； adj. 燃烧的；强烈的；
words.ex: The wood is burning in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头正在壁炉里燃烧。
words.en: A burning issue or problem is very important and needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.ex: The fish is still alive in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼还在水里活着。
words.en: If people or animals are alive, they are not dead.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是西街1071号。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: He works hard during his workday.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作日努力工作。
words.en: A workday is a day on which people go to work.

words.ex: He ate a slice of apple pie for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块苹果派作为甜点。
words.en: A pie is a baked dish which is usually made of a pastry dough casing that contains a filling of various sweet or savoury ingredients.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: By the end of the week, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到周末结束时，他完成了作业。
words.en: Indicates the point in time when something concludes or is expected to conclude.

words.tr:
n. 傻瓜；蠢人；
v. 愚弄；
words.ex: He is a fool for spending all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他是个傻瓜，把所有钱都花在游戏上了。
words.en: A fool is someone who behaves in a silly way without thinking or someone who is tricked into believing or doing something that is not sensible.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.tr: phrase. 化装舞会；化妆派对
words.ex: We wore costumes to the costume party.
words.ex_cn: 我们穿着服装去参加化装派对。
words.en: A costume party is a social gathering where guests are expected to wear costumes, often representing a specific theme or character.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.tr:
n. 骗局；恶作剧；戏弄
v. 愚弄
words.ex: The news was a hoax to scare people.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻是个骗局，为了吓唬人。
words.en: A hoax is a plan to deceive someone, such as telling the police there is a bomb somewhere when there is not, or a trick in which someone tells people a lie.

words.ex: The concert tickets sold out in one hour.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的票在一小时内就卖光了。
words.en: To sell all of the available items or tickets for an event, so that there are no more left for people to buy.

words.ex: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
words.ex_cn: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。
words.en: The act of finding something that had not been known before.

words.ex: The lady is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 这位女士正在等公交车。
words.en: A lady is a woman who is polite, well-mannered, and refined.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.ex: The story is believable.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事令人信服。
words.en: If something is believable, it seems possible, real, or true.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.tr: adj. 令人尴尬的；令人为难的； v. “embarrass”的现在分词；
words.ex: It was embarrassing when I tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 我在大家面前绊倒了，很尴尬。
words.en: Something that is embarrassing makes you feel shy or ashamed.

words.tr: phrase. 新西兰（太平洋南部岛国）
words.ex: He lives in New Zealand.
words.ex_cn: 他住在新西兰。
words.en: An island country in the southwestern Pacific Ocean, known for its stunning landscapes and Maori culture.

words.ex: He visited Italy last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了意大利。
words.en: A country in southern Europe, known for its rich cultural heritage, history, art, and cuisine.

words.ex: The rover is exploring mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器正在探索火星。
words.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Named after the Roman god of war, it is often referred to as the 'Red Planet' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.

words.tr:
n. 无光泽颜色、涂层；哑光漆；衬底；镶边；
adj. 不光亮的；无光泽的；哑光的；
words.ex: The wall has a matt finish.
words.ex_cn: 这面墙有无光泽的涂层。
words.en: A matt surface is one that is not shiny.

words.ex: Kevin is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 凯文正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A proper name, a common given name.

words.tr: n. 粗野之人；下层人；村夫；农夫；人；家伙；
words.ex: Carl is a rough carl who shouts at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 卡尔是个粗野之人，对每个人都大喊大叫。
words.en: A man, especially a rustic or uncouth one.

words.tr: phrase. 奥逊·威尔斯（美国著名导演、演员、编剧，代表作《公民凯恩》）
words.ex: Orson Welles directed a famous radio play called War of the Worlds.
words.ex_cn: 奥森·威尔斯导演了一部著名的广播剧《世界大战》。
words.en: Orson Welles was an American actor, director, writer, and producer who worked in theater, radio, and film. He is remembered for his innovative work in all three media, most notably for his film 'Citizen Kane' (1941), which is often cited as one of the greatest films ever made.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: The fisherman catches fish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫每天早上捕鱼。
words.en: A fisherman is a man who catches fish as a job or for sport.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A bin is a container that you put rubbish in.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有害的；对…造成伤害的
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有害。
words.en: To cause damage or injury to someone or something.

words.ex: The flag is at the top of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在山顶上。
words.en: At the highest part or point of something.

words.ex: The bike has a metal chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一条金属链条。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links which are typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or for transmitting mechanical power.

words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: v. 买得起；担负得起；有时间做；
words.ex: I can't afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.ex: She uses a reusable bottle for water.
words.ex_cn: 她用一个可重复使用的瓶子装水。
words.en: Able to be used again or more than once.

words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸巾擦了擦嘴。
words.en: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes and to wipe your mouth and fingers.

words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 充分利用某物；把某物派上好用场
words.ex: He put his old tools to good use.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧工具好好利用了。
words.en: To use something in a way that is beneficial or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 拆毁（建筑物）；拉下；降低（价格、水平等）
words.ex: They pull down the old house to build a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他们拆掉旧房子来建一所新学校。
words.en: To pull down something means to destroy it or remove it from its position.

words.ex: The upside of working late is more money.
words.ex_cn: 加班的好处是能赚更多钱。
words.en: The upside is the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad.

words.ex: He closed the gate before it rained.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前他关上了门。
words.en: A gate is a structure like a door which is used at the entrance to a field, a garden, or the grounds of a building.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个瓶子里喝水。
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: The painting gave me inspiration.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画给了我灵感。
words.en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.ex: The song brings back happy memories.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了快乐的回忆。
words.en: To bring something back means to return it to the place where it was before, or to make it exist or happen again.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.tr: n. 野生救援（一家致力于保护野生动物的国际非营利组织）
words.ex: WildAid helps protect elephants from poachers.
words.ex_cn: WildAid 帮助保护大象免受偷猎者伤害。
words.en: An organization (WildAid) dedicated to reducing the consumption of illegal wildlife products.

words.tr: abbr. 世界野生动物基金（World Wildlife Fund）；
words.ex: The WWF works to protect endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 世界野生动物基金会致力于保护濒危动物。
words.en: The World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is an international non-governmental organization founded in 1961, working in the field of wilderness preservation, and the reduction of humanity's footprint on the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 世界自然基金会（致力于自然保护的国际性非政府组织）
words.ex: The World Wide Fund for Nature protects animals and forests.
words.ex_cn: 世界自然基金会保护动物和森林。
words.en: The World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is an international non-governmental organization founded in 1961, working in the field of the wilderness preservation, and the reduction of human impact on the environment.

words.ex: Jason is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 杰森是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Greek name Ιάσων (Iason), which possibly means 'healer'.

words.ex: Professor Hayes taught us history last semester.
words.ex_cn: 海斯教授上学期教了我们历史。
words.en: Hayes is a surname of English origin, meaning 'enclosure' or 'hedged area'.

words.ex: Jessica loves to read books in the park.
words.ex_cn: 杰西卡喜欢在公园里读书。
words.en: A proper name, a common given name.

words.tr: phrase. 详细讨论；商量；说服（某人）
words.ex: They talk over their problems every night.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上一起讨论他们的问题。
words.en: To discuss something thoroughly or at length.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
